subject: Discovery recap & next steps — BrightWare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightware.com>, Sasha Lee <sasha.lee@brightware.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-03-01T18:05:00Z
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — BrightWare

Hi Alex / Sasha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid discussion about BrightWare's document ingestion pipeline and latency-sensitive search use case.

Quick recap of what we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce query latency for semantic search across 100M+ documents while keeping embedding costs under control.
- Current setup: in-house TF-based embedder + batch offline reindexing; frequent freshness and cold-start concerns.
- Constraints: data residency in US, SOC2 compliance, and a target P95 query latency < 200ms for read-heavy workloads.

Where Redwood can help (proposed fit):
- Dedicated inference pools for predictable throughput and low P95 latency.
- Prefix KV caching and intelligent batching to reduce per-token cost on retrieval-augmented generations.
- Private deployment option for data residency and KMS integrations.

Next steps I proposed on the call:
1) Send a 1‑pager summary + cost ballpark for a dedicated pilot (attached).
2) If that looks reasonable, schedule a 30‑minute technical deep-dive with Vivek and your infra lead to validate performance assumptions.
3) We can follow up with a pilot SOW and an updated SLA for the P95 target.

Attached: redwood-discovery-recap.pdf (summary + pilot ballpark)

Would 30 minutes next week for a tech deep-dive work for you? I suggested Tue/Wed morning PST — happy to work around your calendar.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0191

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Alex,

Hope you're doing well. I wanted to follow up on the discovery recap I sent a couple of weeks ago and the bump I sent last week.

If BrightWare has decided this isn't a priority right now, no worries — could you please let me know so I can update our pipeline? If you do have bandwidth, two quick asks:
1) Is the proposed pilot scope useful for validating the latency and cost assumptions?
2) If yes, who on your side should we loop into a 30‑minute technical deep-dive? (Vivek and I will keep it focused and can prepare short perf slides.)

If it's helpful, I'm also happy to share a pared-down proposal that targets just the semantic search latency use case to keep cost and ramp low.

Appreciate any quick guidance — even a one-line reply helps.
